Looking to join a dynamic and international work environment within the EU affairs sector in Brussels? We are seeking a versatile Office & IT Administrative Assistant to ensure smooth daily operations and provide high-level support to our professional teams. This role offers an excellent opportunity to learn and expand your skills in both office management and IT administration.

Responsibilities and Shared Tasks

Office Operations: Managing incoming mail (collection and distribution), handling office access badges, and liaising with external vendors to ensure a seamless workplace experience.

Administrative Support: Providing general support to various internal departments, including HR, Finance, and IT.

IT Inventory & Support: Maintaining the inventory of IT equipment (laptops, monitors, phones, printers) and offering basic administrative IT support to staff members.

Facilities & Catering: Preparing meeting rooms (checking equipment and supplies), coordinating catering orders with high-quality providers, and managing the maintenance of coffee machines and water dispensers.

Team Coordination: Acting as a bridge between internal teams and external service providers to ensure all office processes run efficiently.

Experience: Previous experience in office management, administration, or a similar support function.

Languages: Fluency in English is required; a good knowledge of French or Dutch is a strong asset.

IT Skills: Good command of standard office tools; a basic understanding of IT systems and hardware is a definite plus.

Organisational Skills: Capable of handling multiple responsibilities efficiently and meeting deadlines with a strong attention to detail.

Proactivity: A "can-do" mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and address issues before they arise.

Communication: Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with both internal stakeholders and external partners.

International company located in the heart of Brussels.

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Business Systems Analyst (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central) (M/V/X) - Region Antwerp.

Our client is an international organization undergoing a major ERP transformation across several European entities.

In this role, you will contribute to the migration from Microsoft Dynamics NAV to Dynamics 365 Business Central, helping to deliver scalable, standardized, and future-oriented solutions across finance and supply chain operations.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as Business Systems Analyst (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central) (M/V/X) include:

• You analyze current business processes and translate business needs into functional solutions within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• You gather and document requirements across finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, warehouse, and supply chain activities.
• You perform fit-gap analyses and align business requirements with standard Business Central functionalities.
• You configure and validate Business Central solutions, including functional setup and master data support.
• You prepare functional documentation, process flows, user stories, and test scenarios.
• You lead user acceptance testing and coordinate issue resolution with development teams.
• You support data migration, go-live activities, and post-implementation follow-up.
• You act as the key point of contact between business users and technical teams.
• You contribute to ERP standardization and continuous process improvement across multiple international entities.
• You travel regularly to France to collaborate closely with local stakeholders.
• You contribute to ERP standardization and continuous process improvement across multiple international entities.
• You travel regularly to France to collaborate closely with local stakeholders.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or ERP Functional Consultant.
• You bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• You have solid experience across both finance and supply chain domains.
• You have strong knowledge of Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, inventory management, warehouse management, and reporting processes.
• You are familiar with manufacturing, production, distribution, or other supply chain-driven environments.
• You are comfortable leading workshops, gathering requirements, and coordinating testing activities.
• You combine strong analytical thinking with excellent stakeholder management skills.
• You are fluent in French and English.
• You have experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have knowledge of APIs, OData, Power BI, or Power Platform, which is a plus.
• You hold a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central certification, or this is considered an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer | Pharma | Beerse
jobs.description:
As a Commissioning & Qualification Equipment Engineer, you are responsible for preparing, maintaining and executing qualification documentation for GMP-critical equipment, utilities and systems. You ensure that all documentation complies with applicable GMP requirements and internal quality standards. You work closely with C&Q Leads, Subject Matter Experts and project teams to support qualification projects from initiation through completion. Besides document preparation, you also participate in qualification testing and follow-up activities. Your work plays an important role in ensuring that systems remain in a validated and compliant state.
Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Writing qualification documentation including URS, SRS, IA, DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ, QSR and Validation Master Plans
 
• Executing and documenting qualification tests for equipment, utilities and systems
 
• Assessing the impact of changes, deviations and discrepancies on qualification activities
 
• Coordinating document reviews, approval flows and signature processes
 
• Following up punch list items and qualification actions until closure
 
• Supporting internal and external audits and inspections
 
• Managing document archiving in accordance with GMP and GDP requirements

You are structured, quality-minded and eager to learn. You communicate effectively with different stakeholders and enjoy working in a team-oriented GMP environment. At the same time, you are capable of independently managing documentation and qualification activities.

What you bring

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or technical field such as Industrial Engineering, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical Sciences
 
• Strong interest in the pharmaceutical industry and GMP-regulated environments
 
• Excellent technical writing and documentation skills
 
• Experience with engineering systems, utilities or manufacturing equipment is an asset
 
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken

The Top Line
 

Here’s the deal. We’re all about helping researchers break free from tools that just don’t cut it. Unleashing problem-tackling solutions that make a huge difference in the real science they do every day. That’s our mantra, our promise and we own it. Our tribe is different. We thrive on moving fast, taking risks and persevering through failure. We embrace the unknown and we are happy to make mistakes. We are there for each other and we crave diversity because we know that building a truly diverse tribe will make us better at everything.
 

The Job
 

Come work with an all-star product development team to make tools that solve our customers’ most pressing needs. Work on a wide range of products and technologies, right from the early stages all the way to the final launch, developing cool solutions and overcoming technical challenges along the way. Get gritty: determine what the system needs, run tests, troubleshoot problems and make things work. You will be part of a small team that covers all the different disciplines that come into play when developing a new instrument (hardware, software, science, algorithms, etc.). This is a great opportunity to work in a fun and challenging environment where you can make a real impact.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Work with mechanical designers on prototyping and developing new hardware 

• Build small software tools to help test or calibrate the hardware 

• Work closely with the manufacturing engineer to support the transfer to production 

• Report progress in weekly meetings 

• Be ready to be part of a multidisciplinary team and contribute wherever you can  

Qualifications
 
 

• Master or equivalent in Engineering field 

• Exceptional problem-solving skills 

• Analytical mindset 

• Fluent in Dutch and English 

• Experience in programming or strong will to learn 

• LabVIEW experience/knowledge is an asset but not required 

• SolidWorks/Onshape knowledge are a plus 

• Excellent documentation, organizational, teamwork, troubleshooting, problem solving, and communication skills  

Location and Compensation
 

This is a full-time, onsite position in Ghent, Belgium. The gross monthly salary range is €4,000–€5,000, depending on experience and level. Benefits include €10 meal vouchers, medical insurance and group insurance.

Own critical network infrastructure, work with modern technologies and shape the evolution of IT within a stable, people-focused organisation.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating across multiple locations, with a strong focus on service, reliability and digital transformation. Its IT environment supports a broad network of sites and business operations, making availability, security and connectivity essential to its day-to-day activities.

 

As part of a growing IT Infrastructure team, you will join an environment where networking is not simply about keeping systems running: you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work on infrastructure projects and influence how the network evolves.
Network Engineer | The Role
As a Network Engineer, you will take an active role in the operational management and continuous improvement of the organisation's network environment.

• Manage and monitor LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall infrastructure across multiple locations.
• Troubleshoot complex network incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
• Work closely with external technology partners, coordinating their activities and challenging proposed solutions when needed.
• Contribute to network projects, migrations, upgrades and standardisation, while ensuring smooth change management.
• Proactively monitor performance, availability and security, using KPIs and monitoring tools to prevent service degradation and downtime.
• Contribute to automation, security and infrastructure improvements, with opportunities to expand into areas such as cloud, systems or cybersecurity.
Network Engineer | The Profile

• 2+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Systems Engineering or IT Infrastructure.
• Solid knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• Experience with network monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting and change management.
• Familiarity with technologies such as Cisco, Meraki, firewalls, SD-WAN or Network Access Control is a strong plus.
• Interest in automation and scripting using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or APIs.
• Fluent in Dutch or French, professionally proficient in the other national language, with a good command of English.
